approvers: Nobody, I decide alone; site manager's opinion only
reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film and I buy the cheapest thing that is good enough. At about 19 euro per m2 this is many times what film and tape cost me, and I would be adding a new supplier and a new budget line.
objection: Paying around 19 euro per m2 plus a 50% deposit and a 150 m2 minimum to protect glazing that already has factory film. Damage claims on my jobs are small compared with that bill.
instead: Keep the factory film, add cheap protection film and tape on exposed frames, and have my own labourers clean up before handover.
would_change_my_mind: Documented cases where factory film failed on jobs like mine and the repair cost me more than this would, plus a price near 5 euro per m2 all-in with no deposit.
